instructions.content: Define tags and project graph conventions.
Configure target pipelines and caching defaults.
Enforce module boundaries with tag-based depConstraints.
Verify boundary violations fail with nx lint --skip-nx-cache.
Integrate affected commands in CI with an explicit base/head strategy.
MUST tag projects consistently for scope/type-based constraints.
MUST configure targetDefaults for build/test/lint dependency flow.
MUST use affected commands in CI for scalable execution.
With no explicit tags, allow broad dependencies temporarily with a warning and a migration plan; with no target defaults, tasks run independently with reduced optimisation.
With no CI base/head, default to the main branch and document the trade-off.
NEVER create circular dependencies between projects; extract shared contracts to a lower-level library.
NEVER run run-many --all in CI as the default verification path.
NEVER skip target pipeline dependencies in targetDefaults.
NEVER ignore cache inputs and outputs for critical targets.
